name: task_revise
description: Revise mutable working state of the task (plan, strategy_steps, hypotheses, verification_plan, next_action, active_step_id, backlog). Cannot alter task objective, constraints, or remaining budgets.

expected_revision.description: Expected revision sequence number for optimistic concurrency control

expected_state_digest.description: Expected state digest for optimistic concurrency control

mutated_fields.description: List of mutable fields being updated in this revision

next_action.description: Immediate next action to be taken

active_step_id.description: Identifier of the currently executing step

proposed_state.description: Dictionary of proposed updates to mutable task state fields

rationale.description: Explanation or justification for the task state revision
